items.name: Chrome Cross Base
items.desc:
Engineered from robust solid steel with a sleek polished chrome finish, this premium indoor cross base features a 360° smooth-swivelling spindle. 

Designed for flat surfaces, it provides reliable stability for standard feather and teardrop flags (compatible with water weight bags for added stability).
items.imageAlt: Polished chrome cross base with 360-degree rotating spindle for feather and teardrop flags

items.name: Steel Ground Spike
items.imageAlt: Heavy-duty steel ground spike with 360-degree rotating spindle for feather and teardrop beach flags - WOLFLAG wholesale
items.desc: Made from wear-resistant stainless steel, this ground spike securely anchors your beach flag pole for a stable, safe display on lawns, gardens, and outdoor events. Its built-in rotating spindle lets the flag turn freely with the wind, while the pointed design allows for quick installation, easy removal, and compact storage.

items.name: Donut Water Weight Bag
items.desc: Donut Water Weight Bag for Cross Bases! Add extra stability to your feather flag display with the Water Weight Bag. This ring-shaped bag fits over compatible cross bases and can be filled with water to add ballast for outdoor use. Simply empty it after use for easier transport and storage.
items.imageAlt: Wolflag round water weight bag placed over cross base for outdoor banner poles

items.name: Heavy-Duty Water Tank Cross Base
items.desc: Engineered for maximum outdoor wind resistance, this hybrid base combines a heavy-duty steel cross stand with a fillable water tank, weighing approx. 33 lbs (15 kg) when filled. Equipped with a smooth 360° rotating spindle, it ensures your feather and teardrop banners rotate freely without tipping over.

items.name: Beach Flag Sand Auger Spike
items.desc: Heavy-Duty Beach Auger Flag Spike – Ideal for Beaches, Surf Life Saving Events & Outdoor Sponsorship Displays. Fits All Standard Feather & Teardrop Flag Poles.
items.imageAlt: Wolflag heavy-duty sand auger flag pole base with handles for feather banner

items.name: Drive-on Car Wheel Base
items.imageAlt: Heavy-duty car tire base for feather flags and teardrop banners - WOLFLAG manufacturer
items.desc: No ground stakes or heavy water bags required—utilizes the vehicle's own weight for reliable all-weather anchoring.Fits standard outer/inner pole diameters for feather flags, teardrop banners, and swooper flags.

items.name: Wall Mount Base with Rotator
items.imageAlt: Heavy-Duty Wall Mount Bracket with Rotator for Feather Flags - Wolflag
items.desc: Built from premium, rust-resistant stainless steel, this 45-degree wall mount bracket features a heavy-duty 4" x 4" base plate for rock-solid stability on exterior walls and storefronts. Engineered with a smooth-rotating spindle and complete mounting hardware, it allows your feather and teardrop flags to rotate freely in high winds without tangling, maximizing brand visibility 24/7.
